collection.credit:
CREDITS: Lorsieab2 proposed making the full competition suite available in
VV1, VV2, VV3, VV4 and VV5, rewriting each to reflect its setting, and
specifically proposed VV5 Heathen/Isolan competitors and judges with political
tensions. The original VV2 Cooking Contest's premise, mechanics and text are
by Lorsieab2. The game-specific adaptations, fresh dialogue, branching,
political plots and integration notes below are written by ChatGPT.
Existing universal competitions and their previous credits remain intact.

ledger.why: the tech effect on C1 (research reward = tech points)

contest.text:
The villagers of the Southern Shore celebrate the work that helped their settlement survive. Competitors display their creations near the village center while elders tell the children how much knowledge was once lost.
(Cook1) prepares a familiar fish-and-root stew; (cook2) offers an unusual fruit, herb and roasted shellfish dish. A visiting elder who once fed the entire village during a lean season takes the judging spoon.
"If this is meant to honor our survival," (judge.he/she) says, "it must first be survivable." The crowd laughs uneasily.

text_only.reason: the festival's setting, told as scenery; the contest itself gives no reward in the source

contest.name: The First Great Feast

a1.text: The elder praises a humble broth over an extravagant feast.

a2.text: A rancid pot produces a stench so dreadful that everyone flees the square; discard it and postpone judging.

text_only.reason: the crowd runs from a smell; nobody leaves the village
A1's reward, on the same source line

b1.text: An apprentice defeats the master cook.

b2.text: Both dishes use the same ancient recipe; the judge awards a tie and asks for stories of the ancestors who taught it.

c1.text: One contestant reveals a clever preservation method.

c2.text: An unsafe ingredient is identified and removed before tasting.
